# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

body: Atomicity clarification (follow-up commit 3d3f99692b): the initial draft described manifest/snapshot ordering but did not make active-shard writes invisible during bounded writes. That is insufficient: a reader could discover rows before the final hash bump. The revised §3.5/§6 now requires immutable per-tier candidate shards and occurrence overlays, hidden from the committed manifest set, followed by a single per-tier catalog commit as the visibility point; fan-out pins that committed manifest generation once at query start. Snapshot ids derive from committed manifests, not live mutable counts. Cross-tier publication is explicitly independent, with per-tier snapshot ids. The indefinite DO cache may still return a coherent stale result until #6805/#6666 provide freshness; the doc no longer claims cache freshness or atomicity. `git diff --check` passes; docs-only change.

You have reached your Codex usage limits for code reviews. You can see your limits in the [Codex usage dashboard](https://chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/usage).
To continue using code reviews, add credits to your account and enable them for code reviews in your [settings](https://chatgpt.com/settings/code-review).

**Shepherd outcome — landed (task 17300, lane any-c, 2026-11-16)**

PR #7707 MERGED, merge sha `f420d7e95a853ef860b055536cc87737c1a8bb61`.

Dispositions of the three Codex P2 findings (each answered on its review thread):

1. *Visibility barrier* — already addressed by the prior head commit 3d3f99692b (§6.3 prepare/commit/read protocol: hidden candidate artifacts, one per-tier catalog commit as the single visibility point, generation-pinned reads); the comment predated that fix.
2. *Verdict invalidation on retry* — fixed in 304d4f557c (§5.3): stage verdicts are bound to stage-input identities (batch id + input content hashes in the gate record); changed inputs re-enter at the earliest changed stage and invalidate every downstream verdict.
3. *Occurrence writes under full dedup suppression* — fixed in 304d4f557c (§4): publish is skippable only with zero survivors **and** no occurrence additions pending; occurrence-only units publish and advance the snapshot id.

The design was not landed elsewhere (the doc was absent on main) and #6057 remains open for its §9 implementation follow-ons.
